## Welcome!

This issue is your first contribution exercise. Filling it in is step one; the rest is in the [GitHub Onboarding guide](https://thenightfox-1.github.io/SustainableTogether/github-onboarding/#your-first-contribution-add-yourself-to-the-wall).

## About me

_Name, and a line about your role or background (student, engineer, sustainability enthusiast — anything)._

## What brings me to SustainableTogether?

_One or two sentences on why you joined and what you are interested in._

## My plan for this issue

- [ ] Add a row about myself to `docs/onboarding-roster.md`
- [ ] Open a pull request that closes this issue with `Closes #N`

_A maintainer will say hello and confirm. Then make your change with any of the three methods in the onboarding guide (the browser is easiest). Welcome aboard!_
